response.overview: Flor has just graduated from high school and finds herself at the most crucial moment of her young life: choosing a future. While she receives an invitation for a prestigious dance scholarship abroad, her mother has already mapped out a conventional college career for her. Caught between her mother’s expectation's and the fear of a future she doesn’t want to live, Flor explores the true limits of a mother’s love and the price of her personal freedom.
response.tagline: The hardest dance step is the one that takes you far from home.
response.title: Échappé
